8192 out of memory pool. I probably need to adjust this default based on the number of concurrent user connections.

```
#
# pool:
#
# o The Number of Default Memory Pool Size
#
#   - Pool-size 128         => 8192 Number
#   - Pool-size 256         => 4096 Number
#   - Pool-size 512         => 2048 Number
#   - Pool-size 1024        => 1024 Number
#   - Pool-size 2048        => 512 Number
#   - Pool-size 8192        => 128 Number
#   - Pool-size 1024*1024   => 8 Number
#
#    128:  8192
#    256:  4096
#    512:  2048
#    1024: 1024
#    2048: 512
#    8192: 128
#    big:  8
#
```

Adding the following to smf.yaml and sgwc.yaml increases the memory pool.
```
pool:
   8192: 512
```


Up to 43 UE are now connected well. First of all, would you like to change it to 512 for 8192 memory pool?

Thanks a lot!
